description: Only right.pick_right changes its first i32 literal from 33 to 35. The dep generic body and type are unchanged.

expected_invalidation.note: Only a caller package changes. The i32 instance identity is unchanged; a future implementation may reuse the dep instance and must still relink the new right object.

measurement_note: expected_invalidation is a design expectation only; this reference run measures language result, not cache hits.
